name: ITER Internship Programme
amount: €1,300/month (EU universities) or €1,500/month (non-EU universities) for Master's-level; €700/month for Bachelor's-level
dlText: Positions posted in recruitment campaigns; check the internships page
fields: Fusion engineering, physics, IT, project management, administration
note: Paid internships at the ITER fusion project for students enrolled in a member-country institution who hold an ITER Member passport (EU, China, India, Japan, Korea, Russia, US). UK applicants are currently not accepted; internships under two months or fully remote are unpaid.

name: IRENA Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend for interns not sponsored by another body (amount in each vacancy; check official page)
fields: Renewable energy policy, finance, data, technology, communications
note: IRENA internships last two to six months and come with a monthly stipend towards living and accommodation costs, unless the intern is already sponsored by a government or university.

name: AIIB Global Internship Program
amount: USD 90 per workday + round-trip economy flight for eligible in-person interns from outside Beijing
dlText: 28 Feb 2027 (annual deadline; time not stated) – estimated from 2026 cycle

eligibility.note: Open to students worldwide; AIIB normally recruits nationals of its member countries – check the call.

fields: Infrastructure finance, investment, economics, law, IT, corporate functions
note: Two-month summer internships at AIIB headquarters in Beijing with a USD 90 daily stipend and a return flight for eligible interns. Applications close 28 February each year.

name: UNOPS Internships
host: United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)
amount: Monthly stipend if not funded by another institution (amount stated in each vacancy) + possible one-time USD 500 travel lump sum
fields: Project management, procurement, infrastructure, partnerships, communications, ICT
note: UNOPS interns may receive a monthly stipend when they have no funding from other institutions; the amount is listed in each vacancy announcement. Interns arrange their own accommodation and visas.

name: UN Women Internship Programme
amount: Stipend for basic daily costs if not funded by a university/government/scholarship (check official page)
fields: Gender equality, human rights, policy, communications, programme support
note: Interns are not salaried but may receive a stipend covering basic daily costs such as meals and local transport when no other body funds them. Some country offices run unpaid internships, so check each vacancy.

name: IIASA Young Scientists Summer Program (YSSP)
host: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)
amount: Funding via your country's IIASA National Member Organization or IIASA YSSP scholarships (check official page)

eligibility.note: PhD students of any nationality; funding comes from IIASA National Member Organizations or the YSSP Fund for those without NMO support.

fields: Systems analysis: climate, energy, food, water, population, risk
note: Three-month summer research stay at IIASA near Vienna for PhD students, ideally one to two years from completion. Participants are funded through their National Member Organization or IIASA scholarships; applications for YSSP 2027 are open now.

name: Gavi Internship Programme
amount: Fixed Gavi stipend for basic living expenses for interns not sponsored by their university (check official page)
fields: Global health, vaccine programmes, finance, policy, communications
note: Gavi interns who are not sponsored by their university receive a fixed stipend for basic living costs. Placements in Geneva or Washington DC run 6–24 weeks; interns pay their own travel and housing.

name: GGGI Internship Program
amount: Paid (check official page; a 2022 posting listed USD 500/month)
fields: Green growth, climate finance, sustainable energy, policy
note: GGGI internships of three to six months carry a modest monthly stipend; travel, insurance and accommodation are the intern's responsibility. Openings are posted on GGGI's careers site.

name: CTBTO Internship Programme
amount: €500/month stipend + up to €500/month for accommodation, for interns without other funding (subject to funds)
fields: Seismology, radionuclide science, IT, legal, political affairs
note: Interns without external funding may receive a EUR 500 monthly stipend plus up to EUR 500 towards rent, subject to available funds. Interns cover their own travel to Vienna.

name: ILRI Graduate Fellowship Programme
amount: Minimum stipend USD 1,000/month (Kenya, Asia, other sites) or USD 550/month (Ethiopia)
fields: Livestock science, animal health, genetics, agricultural economics
note: Graduate fellows (MSc/PhD students) do thesis research at ILRI sites in Kenya, Ethiopia and Asia with a monthly stipend paid in local currency. Openings are posted on ILRI's graduate fellowship page.

name: EFSA Traineeship Programme
amount: Monthly maintenance grant (amount set in each call) + travel reimbursement
dlText: ~15 Apr 2027 (time not stated) – estimated from 2026 cycle

eligibility.note: EU nationals; a limited number of non-EU nationals are also accepted.

nextText: Annual call; 2026 call ran 11 Mar–15 Apr 2026
fields: Food safety science, risk assessment, data, communications, administration
note: Paid traineeships at EFSA in Parma with a monthly grant and travel reimbursement. Mainly for EU citizens, but some places go to non-EU graduates (visa required).

name: ICRC Graduate Traineeships (Geneva)
host: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)
amount: About CHF 3,934 gross/month (13 instalments); Swiss work permit arranged
fields: Humanitarian law, operations, data, communications, archives, finance
note: Salaried graduate traineeships at ICRC headquarters in Geneva for recent graduates with little professional experience. Student traineeships of up to 90 days are unpaid.

name: IUCN Internships
host: International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)
country: Any (IUCN offices; e.g. Washington DC, Gland)
amount: Stipend set per office (e.g. USD 1,500/month full-time in Washington DC postings; check each vacancy)

eligibility.note: Depends on duty station and local work authorisation – check each vacancy.

fields: Conservation, biodiversity assessment, forests, climate, communications
note: IUCN offices post internships individually with stipends set by the duty station; recent Washington DC postings paid USD 1,500 a month full-time. Some regional internships may be externally funded or self-funded.
